title: Submitting observations from a bird count
titleZh: 提交鳥類計數觀察紀錄
passage: Thanks for taking part in this morning’s bird count. Please send us one list per household by tonight. If two people in the same household saw the same bird together, put it on the list once, not twice. We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center. If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it. Do not guess the species. A photo is helpful, but you can still send a list without one.
passageZh: 謝謝大家參加今天早上的鳥類觀察計數。請每戶在今晚以前提交一份名單。同一戶的兩個人如果一起看到同一隻鳥，只要在那份名單上記一次，不要記兩次。我們要收的是池塘步道的觀察紀錄，不是遊客中心餵食台的紀錄。若無法辨認某隻鳥，就寫下它的大小和看到牠的地點，不要猜種類。附照片會有幫助，但沒有照片也能交名單。
audioScript: Thanks for taking part in this morning’s bird count. Please send us one list per household by tonight. If two people in the same household saw the same bird together, put it on the list once, not twice. We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center. If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it. Do not guess the species. A photo is helpful, but you can still send a list without one.
